T-272 is live and in review: per-teammate tokens, per-week links, the Cohort Settings additions and the vendor cleanup. I couldn't run the revoke check live because creating a token needs the owner key.

decisions.decision:
T-251 has landed, so the old blocker is gone. Branch from current main, not tantra-walkthroughs, and re-find the AUDIT.md line numbers on main. Build:
- H057: a D1 migration for an admin_tokens table (id, teammate, hash, created, revoked_at). Entry is a POST form at /admin/enter; never accept ?k=. Add a Teammates panel that can create and revoke tokens. Keep ADMIN_KEY as an owner fallback through POST only.
- H058: store join and recording links per cohort week. Read join links from zoom-pro.ts first, then fall back to the stored links.
- H059 and N097: in Cohort Settings, add the read-only preview, session_minutes, and per-day slides and description fields.
- H062: remove the verifier gates and these vendors from VENDOR: GoDaddy, Instantly, SendGrid, Calendly, HeyReach, Apollo, BuiltWith, NeverBounce, ZeroBounce. Add the legend. Leave connector deletion to T-300; leave Wistia to T-260.
- H065: use plural() in the Overview stat.
Probe all of it: revoke one token while another keeps working, and check two weeks show different links. Deploy, mark the six ids fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit, then move to review.
